text: 中国基金业协会最新发布的数据显示，截至2026年8月底，我国境内公募基金资产净值合计39.63万亿元。截至2026年8月底，我国境内公募基金管理机构共165家，其中基金管理公司150家，取得公募资格的资产管理机构15家。（新华社）
text_en: The latest data released by the Asset Management Association of China show that as of the end of August 2026, the total net asset value of public funds in China was 39.63 trillion yuan. As of the end of August 2026, there were 165 public fund management institutions in China, including 150 fund management companies and 15 asset management institutions qualified for public fund management. (Xinhua News Agency)
